recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Reintroducing top-level BodyStructure.location/locationQualifier or moving morphology back to the top level would conflict with later published/applied BodyStructure restructurings; any future change should be handled through a new OO decision rather than as FHIR-13394 cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-13394 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for STU3 asking BodySite/BodyStructure to distinguish the represented thing from its body location: rename BodyStructure.code to BodyStructure.location, add BodyStructure.morphology 0..1 with short 'Kind of structure' and an example SNOMED CT morphologic abnormality binding, rename BodyStructure.qualifier to BodyStructure.locationQualifier, and add V2 mappings.
initial_application: The issue was preapplied in the old spreadsheet source before current XML StructureDefinition source was introduced. Git history shows cc0dad0855 preapplied #13394/#13396 by changing BodyStructure.code to BodyStructure.morphology, retaining BodyStructure.location, renaming BodyStructure.qualifier to BodyStructure.locationQualifier, and tagging the morphology row with #13394. Git history also shows 341df2e7a6 added the requested GF#13394 V2 mappings.
additional_context: The current build has BodyStructure active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied/published BodyStructure decisions intentionally changed the shape: FHIR-33129 replaced top-level location/locationQualifier with includedStructure/excludedStructure backbone elements, and FHIR-48110 moved morphology into BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology. Related issues FHIR-13396, FHIR-33129, and FHIR-48110 are already represented on the combined branch, so no duplicate related decisions were published.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already has BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology 0..1 with committee note #13394, short 'Kind of Structure', a definition/comment preserving the location-versus-morphology distinction, example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/bodystructure-code, and a V2 SPM-4/SPM-5 mapping. The value set is the SNOMED CT Morphologic Abnormalities hierarchy, examples use separate includedStructure.structure and morphology, and the morphology search parameter points at BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology.
